The band consists of Luke Boerdam (vocals, guitar), James Tidswell (guitar), Luke Henery (bass) and Michael Richards (drums).  Their sound has been compared to that of 1980s and 1990s alternative rock bands such as the Pixies, Mudhoney and Nirvana.  The band's third studio album, "Hungry Ghost", was certified Gold in Australia in September 2014.  Their fourth album, "WACO", debuted at number 1 on the Australian iTunes and ARIA charts in 2016.
